note: NOTE: General item table. item_type = material | gear | currency | misc | consumable. subtype_id is used for materials only. Currencies: Nature / Elemental / Spirit Essence (category upgrades) and Monster Essence (basic skills only); Copper Coin is money. Consumables are meadow-flavored (Meadow Dew, Clear Dew, Spring Draught, Mint Draught, Barley Cake, Wild Apple, Mint Sprig). They can be bought from the Meadows vendor (npc_shop). Healing and MP drinks drop only from some thematically related monsters, not from every mob. Misc includes common junk, a few mid curios (found objects, hoarded things, byproducts — not a body-part trophy on every monster), and rare high-sell junk that only some monsters share. Crafting is deferred. Meadows leans earth.

rows.name: Nature Essence
rows.description: The Nature upgrade currency. Sought-after — large amounts mean a lot of power.
rows.notes: DRAFT. Currency. Main gate for Nature skills and the Nature passive tree. Dropped by Nature monsters (20-30%, 1-3; bosses more). Produced by the Nature tree (steep curve). Commons (Twig, Bark, Pebble, Clay, Wool, Feather, Fur) can be exchanged at 10:1. Not the same as Monster Essence.

rows.name: Elemental Essence
rows.description: The Elemental upgrade currency. Sought-after — large amounts mean a lot of power.
rows.notes: DRAFT. Currency. Main gate for Elemental skills and the Elemental passive tree. Dropped by Elemental monsters (20-30%, 1-3). Produced by the Elemental tree (steep curve). Earth Grit and shards can be exchanged at 10:1. Not the same as Monster Essence or Earth Shard.

rows.name: Spirit Essence
rows.description: The Spirit upgrade currency. Sought-after — large amounts mean a lot of power.
rows.notes: DRAFT. Currency. Main gate for Spiritual skills and the Spiritual passive tree. Dropped by Spiritual monsters (20-30%, 1-3; bosses more). Produced by the Spiritual tree (steep curve). Holy Dust and Soul Dust can be exchanged at 10:1. Not the same as Monster Essence, Holy Essence, or Soul Shard.
